clue.text: In retreat, as well to secure inconclusive result

indicators.note: to secure something is to hold it fast, so one word wraps round the other

parts.note: withal is an old word meaning as well or besides
a draw is a game with no winner

explanation.surface: A side in retreat hopes at least to hang on for a draw.
explanation.definitionFit: A withdrawal is a pulling back of troops, the same military sense as a retreat.

clue.text: Bird flew over one riverbed

indicators.note: in a down clue, flying over sends the word upwards, so it reads backwards

parts.note: the daw, or jackdaw, is a crow-family bird
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A bird flies across a single dry riverbed.
explanation.definitionFit: A wadi is a desert valley or watercourse that is dry except in the rainy season.

clue.text: Hairstyle that's tied for first prize?

definitions.text: Hairstyle that's tied for first prize?

parts.words: Hairstyle that's tied for first prize?
parts.note: read as a hairdo knotted on the crown of the head, but the second sense joins a word for first place to a word for something tied

explanation.surface: A hairdo that shares the top award in a competition.
explanation.definitionFit: A topknot is hair gathered into a knot on top of the head, a recognised hairstyle.

clue.text: Opera more tragic than The Gondo- D NAIV liers?

annotationWithheld.why: Clue held as 'Opera more tragic than The Gondo- D NAIV liers?': OCR has spliced grid letters 'D NAIV' into the word Gondoliers; the scan crop is blank and a search of the exact text finds nothing, so the printed clue cannot be confirmed.
annotationWithheld.clue: Opera more tragic than The Gondo- D NAIV liers?

clue.text: Ancient gaoled in error

indicators.note: a word in error is wrongly put together, so its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: An old prisoner was locked up by mistake.
explanation.definitionFit: Age-old describes something that has existed for a very long time, so it is a synonym of ancient.

clue.text: Launch appeal over tax; expert makes the case

indicators.note: the expert word forms a case or casing round the other pieces

parts.note: an ace is a skilled expert

indicators.note: in a down clue, over means the word is turned upwards, read backwards

parts.note: IT is slang for sex appeal
VAT is value added tax, the British sales tax

explanation.surface: An expert lodges an appeal against a tax bill and argues the case.
explanation.definitionFit: To activate a scheme or device is to set it going, which is what launch means as a verb.

clue.text: Ring up, but not a hearty greeting

indicators.note: a greeting with no heart loses its central letter

parts.note: hallo is a greeting, a form of hello

explanation.surface: A phone call that does not begin with a warm welcome.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not a hearty' removes the middle L of HALLO. 'Ring up' looks like a phone call but describes a circle up above the head.
explanation.definitionFit: A halo is the ring of light shown above a saint's head, so a ring that sits up high.

clue.text: Time to break into song? His hero was furious

indicators.note: the time letter breaks into the song word, sitting inside it

parts.note: an arioso is a melodious song-like passage in opera

explanation.surface: Someone decides the moment has come to burst into song.
explanation.walkthrough: Ariosto's epic poem is Orlando Furioso, 'Orlando gone mad', so his hero was furious.
explanation.definitionFit: The Italian poet wrote Orlando Furioso, whose title hero is driven raving mad.

clue.text: Writer's care to get into wordbook, prepared to learn

indicators.note: the writer and care pieces get inside the dictionary letters

parts.note: OED is the Oxford English Dictionary
a pen is a writer, and the 's is read as 'is'
to mind is to care

explanation.surface: An author takes pains to get a word into the dictionary.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone open-minded is receptive to new ideas, ready to learn from them.

clue.text: Corrupt deputy joins party

parts.note: a rave is a large lively party

explanation.surface: A crooked deputy turns up at a party.
explanation.definitionFit: To deprave is to corrupt someone morally; both are verbs.

clue.text: Social type at first teases hermit, losing some energy

indicators.note: only the opening letter of teases is taken
the hermit gives up a part of itself, its first letter

parts.note: E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: Someone teases a recluse until he loses his energy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'losing some' drops the H of hermit to give ERMIT. Termites live in highly organised colonies, so are social insects.
explanation.definitionFit: Termites are social insects living in large colonies, so one is a social type of creature.

clue.text: Tune librarian adapted for anti-slavery song

indicators.note: the letters are altered to suit a new form, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: A librarian rearranges a tune to make an abolitionist song.
explanation.walkthrough: The song's refrain says 'Britons never will be slaves', which the clue playfully calls anti-slavery.
explanation.definitionFit: The patriotic song's refrain declares Britons never will be slaves, so it is jokingly anti-slavery.

clue.text: No tipping, honest!

definitions.meaning: something level is flat, not tilted either way
an exclamation assuring someone that one is being truthful and straight

explanation.definitionFit: Being on the level means being flat, and also, idiomatically, being genuine and truthful.

clue.text: Boy, no son to strong man

indicators.note: no son means the son letters are dropped

parts.note: Samson is the biblical strong man
taken as written

explanation.surface: A boy who is not related to a muscleman.
explanation.definitionFit: Sam is a common boy's name, so it stands for a boy.

clue.text: Put on green outfit with enthusiasm

indicators.note: in a down clue, the outfit is put on top of the rest

parts.note: a get-up is an outfit or costume
and means with, joining things
green is the traffic-light signal for go

explanation.surface: Someone eagerly dresses in a green costume.
explanation.definitionFit: Get-up-and-go is an idiom for energy and drive, much the same as enthusiasm.

clue.text: Taking, say, a loaf in

indicators.note: the a and loaf pieces go in the example letters

parts.note: EG, for example, is signalled by say
a tin is a loaf baked in a tin, a tin loaf

explanation.surface: Someone takes, for example, a loaf indoors.
explanation.definitionFit: Eating is taking food in; 'taking' a meal or a medicine means consuming it.

clue.text: Determined it's a bit of a fag to get started

parts.note: fag is British slang for a cigarette, and the stub is the bit left over
to be born is to start life

explanation.surface: Getting started on something is rather a chore.
explanation.walkthrough: In British English a fag is a cigarette, and 'a fag' also means a tiresome chore, which the surface uses.
explanation.definitionFit: A stubborn person is fixed in their purpose, so determined in an obstinate way.

clue.text: Shortly arrive at puzzle: he makes notes

indicators.note: the word is cut short, losing its last letter

parts.note: to come is to arrive
a poser is a puzzling question

explanation.surface: Someone arrives briefly at a puzzle and writes notes on it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Shortly' cuts the E from COME. 'makes notes' suggests jotting, but the notes are musical.
explanation.definitionFit: A composer writes music, literally setting down musical notes.

clue.text: Slave was entitled to a cabin

definitions.text: Slave was entitled to a cabin

parts.words: Slave was entitled to a cabin
parts.note: read as a slave having a right to a hut, but 'entitled' means a novel's title gave a cabin to this slave

explanation.surface: An enslaved man had a right to a hut of his own.
explanation.walkthrough: Harriet Beecher Stowe's novel is titled with the slave's name plus 'Cabin', so the cabin is his in the title.
explanation.definitionFit: The enslaved hero of Harriet Beecher Stowe's novel, whose title names his cabin.

clue.text: One piece of pine inside another — that smells nice

indicators.note: the log goes inside the cone

parts.note: another piece of pine is a cone, the tree's fruit
a log is a piece of a pine tree

explanation.surface: A bit of pine wood fitted into another bit of pine smells pleasant.
explanation.definitionFit: Cologne, or eau de Cologne, is a light perfume, something that smells nice.

clue.text: Group of friends comes round

definitions.meaning: a set of people who know each other, a social set
to move round something in a ring, as a bird might

explanation.definitionFit: A circle is a social set of friends, and to circle is to move round in a ring.

clue.text: Verse a stunning success: judge's call

parts.note: a coup is a sudden striking success
let is the tennis umpire's call when a serve clips the net

explanation.surface: A poem is a triumph, as the critic declares.
explanation.definitionFit: A couplet is a pair of rhyming lines, a small unit of verse.

clue.text: A Finn not taken seriously

definitions.meaning: a ... Finn is a drugged drink, often shortened
to take the ... is to mock someone, so the ... is what is taken

explanation.definitionFit: A mickey is short for a Mickey Finn, a spiked drink, and taking the mickey is teasing.

clue.text: Sink lake beside road

indicators.note: the lake letter is placed next to the road

parts.note: the A1 is Britain's longest road, written AI in crosswords

explanation.surface: A lake lies next to a road.
explanation.walkthrough: The A1 is the main road from London to Edinburgh; its 1 is read as the letter I.
explanation.definitionFit: To ail is to be unwell and decline in health, as a patient sinks.

clue.text: Church approval of royal seized by Zulus —- victim of persecution, it's said

indicators.note: the royal letter is held inside the Zulu word

parts.note: an impi is a Zulu regiment of warriors
R is short for royal, as in RN

indicators.note: the following word is heard spoken, giving letters that sound like it

parts.note: a martyr suffers and dies for their beliefs

explanation.surface: A royal held by Zulu warriors becomes a martyr, as the church sanctions it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'seized by' puts R in IMPI to give IMPRI; 'it's said' turns MARTYR into the sound MATUR.
explanation.definitionFit: An imprimatur is the Roman Catholic church's official licence to print a book, a mark of approval.

clue.text: River's middle avoided by stranger

indicators.note: the central letter of the word is skipped

parts.note: odder means stranger, more peculiar

explanation.surface: Someone stranger keeps away from the middle of a river.
explanation.definitionFit: The Oder is a major river of central Europe, along the German-Polish border.

clue.text: Risks taking good, not new, weapons

indicators.note: the risks word takes in one letter
the other letter is not kept, it gives way

parts.note: dangers are risks

explanation.surface: Someone takes risks with weapons that are good but not new.
explanation.walkthrough: 'taking good, not new' swaps the N of DANGERS for a G.
explanation.definitionFit: Daggers are short stabbing knives, a kind of weapon.

clue.text: Generous sort of display was inspiring

parts.note: kind means generous
an LED display uses light-emitting diodes

explanation.surface: A generous kind of exhibition was inspiring.
explanation.definitionFit: Kindled means aroused or stirred up, the same as was inspiring, as of a passion.

clue.text: Lowers subsequent return shortly to zero

parts.note: O resembles the digit zero

indicators.note: the shortened word is turned back to front
the word is cut short, losing its last letter

parts.note: next means following, subsequent

explanation.surface: Reductions follow, returning the figure to zero.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lowers' looks like a verb meaning reduces, but it names animals that low, or moo.
explanation.definitionFit: Lowers here are animals that low, or moo, and oxen are cattle.

clue.text: Issue lacking clear boundaries needs intelligence

parts.note: a grey area lacks clear lines, so grey means ill-defined
a matter is an issue or topic

explanation.surface: A vague issue demands some thought.
explanation.definitionFit: Grey matter is the brain tissue, and informally a person's brains or intelligence.
